title: At least 17 killed in South Africa shooting, police hunt for eight suspects - Al Jazeera
description: Incidents in Wedela southwest of Johannesburg and Lwandle near Cape Town come days after Durban mass shooting.

title: Host Jalen Brunson gets assist from Knicks on 'SNL' premiere - ESPN
description: Jalen Brunson had four of his Knicks teammates -- Karl-Anthony Towns, Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby and Josh Hart -- in the audience for his monologue Saturday night, in his role as host of "SNL."

title: UFC Vegas 121: Raoni Barcelos stretchered out, hospitalized after scary fifth-round KO by Raul Rosas Jr. - Yahoo Sports
description: Barcelos appeared to lose consciousness post-fight and has been transported to the hospital. His condition remains uncertain.
